newsitem.title: USA: Aristo files for up two million shares.
newsitem.headline: Aristo files for up two million shares.

text.p: Aristo International Corp said on Wednesday that it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up to two million common shares.
The company said it will use the proceeds for system and product development, capital expenditures, product launches, software licensing and general corporate purposes.
Allen & Co Inc has been granted an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 additional shares. After the offering there will be 16,966,661 common shares outstanding.
The New York City-based company designs and develops located-based, pay-per-play electronic game and entertainment units and music juke boxes which are networked through the Internet.
